hazard: Lack of CPR training among carers

reports.title: Charles Evans: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: None of the Carers employed at Hibiscus House had any training in CPR
concerns.hazard: lack of CPR training among carers

concerns.quote: There was no Registered First Aider at the premises
There was no defibrillator on site
There was no emergency bell/alarm or telephone in the residents' dining room
Post inquest, the Coroner noted the CQC Inspection report for Hibiscus House Domiciliary Care Agency dated July 2019 which rated the facility as 'requiring improvement'
concerns.hazard: inadequate CQC follow-up on improvement plan

reports.title: Jake O'Brien: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: No ongoing training had been provided to prison officers since initial training on basic life support or first aid, meaning that officers confronted with discovery of a ligature situation were unable to provide immediate and basic life support due to a lack of confidence and unfamiliarity of what to do in a situation when every second can count in promoting the chances of an optimal recovery
concerns.hazard: lack of immediate basic life support in ligature situations

links.explanation: Both reports highlight a lack of required lifesaving training (CPR/BLS) that leaves staff unable to provide immediate emergency assistance.
